Load data

```{r load_study_data}

df_asd_rarevar_zscore <- readRDS(file.path(analysis_dir, "00_data_format", "00_01_ASD-rarevar-stats.RDS"))
```

# --- 1) Calculate GO cosine similarity for each ASD module ---

```{r GO_similarity}
sig_mods <- df_stepwise_res$module

all_module_nets <- map(
    .x = sig_mods,
    .f = ~ {
        
        print(paste0("Calculating GO similarity for ", .x))
        
        # Filter for module data
        mod_data <- df_network_data %>% 
            unnest(cols = c(data)) %>%
            filter(module == .x)
        
        # Extract module genes
        mod_genes <- mod_data %>% 
            pull(gene_name) %>% 
            unique()
        
        # Include module hub/TF if it isn't already (i.e., not an ASD risk gene)
        mod_label <- mod_data %>% 
            pull(module_label) %>% 
            unique
        mod_label <- str_remove(mod_label, "\\ .*")
        
        # GO cosine similarity among these genes (BP ontology)
        mod_net <- build_go_network(
            unique(c(mod_genes, mod_label)),
            go_mapping = go_mapping %>% filter(ontology == "BP"),
            gene_stats = df_asd_rarevar_zscore
        )
        
        return(mod_net)
    }
)
names(all_module_nets) <- sig_mods

# Save the network object for plotting
saveRDS(all_module_nets, file = file.path(notebook_out_dir, "04_03_all-module-GO-similarity-graphs.RDS"))
```


# --- 2) Plot GO similarity graphs across modules ---

```{r plot_and_export, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 5}
# Node attributes shared across modules
node_stats <- df_asd_rarevar_zscore %>%
    left_join(df_gene_assignments, by = join_by(gene_name)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(gene_name, GO_topic, log_bf = log_BF)

# Generate plots
module_plot_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "module_plots")

all_module_plots <- map(
    .x = names(all_module_nets),
    .f = ~ {
        
        print(paste0("Creating plot for ", .x))
        
        # Extract module graph
        mod_net <- all_module_nets[[.x]]
        
        # Extract hub gene/TF to bold
        mod_label <- df_network_data %>% 
            unnest(cols = c(data)) %>% 
            filter(module == .x) %>% 
            pull(module_label)
        mod_label <- str_remove(mod_label, "\\ .*")

        # Build the module GO-similarity graph on ASD risk genes in the module:
        # each node linked to its top-3 non-zero-similarity partners (go_knn_edges)
        mod_genes <- df_network_data %>%
            unnest(cols = c(data)) %>%
            filter(module == .x) %>%
            pull(gene_name)
        risk_genes <- df_asd_rarevar_zscore %>%
            filter(FDR < 0.001 & !FLAG & gene_name %in% mod_genes) %>%
            pull(gene_name)
        genes_to_plot <- unique(c(mod_label, risk_genes))

        # only genes in the GO-BP similarity matrix can have edges (some hub TFs have no
        # GO-BP annotation and aren't in sim_mat)
        in_sim <- intersect(genes_to_plot, rownames(mod_net$sim_mat))
        mod_edges <- go_knn_edges(mod_net$sim_mat[in_sim, in_sim, drop = FALSE], k_nn = 3) %>%
            filter(similarity > 0)
        # keep ALL genes as vertices so the hub/TF (and any isolated risk gene) still shows
        mod_net_for_plot <- graph_from_data_frame(mod_edges, directed = FALSE,
                                                  vertices = tibble(name = genes_to_plot))
        
        # Shared scale limits
        sim_rng   <- E(mod_net_for_plot)$similarity %>% range()
        logbf_rng <- node_stats %>%
            filter(gene_name %in% V(mod_net_for_plot)$name) %>%
            pull(log_bf) %>% range(na.rm = TRUE)
        
        # Plot (single graph): only hub gene/TF bolded; larger node size range; GO-topic fill legend shown
        # (nodes span multiple topics here)
        p_mod <- plot_go_graph(
            net = mod_net_for_plot, node_stats = node_stats, bold_genes = mod_label,
            title = paste0("ASD Genes in ", mod_label),
            size_range = c(2, 6), size_limits = logbf_rng, 
            edge_range = c(0.01, 0.50), edge_limits = sim_rng, edge_color = "gray60",
            topic_legend = FALSE, xmult = 0.05, ymult = 0.05,
            seed = 1221
        )
        
        # Export plot
        ggsave(
            filename = file.path(module_plot_dir, paste0(mod_label, ".pdf")),
            height = 5, width = 5.5,
            dpi = 300
        )
        
        # Print plot
        return(p_mod)
    }
)

pdf(file.path(module_plot_dir, "all_module_plots.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5)
walk(all_module_plots, print)
dev.off()

all_module_plots
```
